task_title: Implement a two-candidate speculative merge train

plan_review.notes: Reviewer rejected push-triggered synthetic CI and direct-main-only promotion. Alt A single-head queue is simpler but gives up approved latency goal. Alt B staging PR preserves audit but cannot guarantee the final exact tested SHA. Alt C rebase plus normal squash merge creates an untested final SHA. Adopted trusted workflow_dispatch validation with no privileged token in candidate-executing jobs; immutable two-candidate commits; queued labels suppress normal auto-merge/rebase; promotion first rewrites the original same-repo PR head to the tested candidate then fast-forwards main to that exact SHA, allowing GitHub to record the PR merged. Candidate fingerprints include base/head/title/review state; admission is mandatory for same-repo ready PRs; all mutation is globally FIFO, idempotent, fail-closed, and dry-run by default.
